direct_dependency_changes.rationale: Installed Bandit bins need the tsx loader available in consumer repos without relying on this development checkout's node_modules.

dependency_manifest_state.rationale: BANDIT-071 promotes an already-present development dependency to runtime scope so private packed installs can execute the CLI. No new package name, package-manager script, registry publication, hosted update service, or automatic self-update is added.

lockfile_state.manifest_rationale: Lockfile changes mirror the package.json scope move for tsx from development-only to runtime dependency.
lockfile_state.drift_rationale: Lockfile drift is expected and bounded to clearing dev-only markers for tsx and its transitive runtime packages so installed consumers receive the loader.

agent_skills.freshness_rule: No installed or repo-local agent skill surface changed for BANDIT-071.

rationale: BANDIT-071 touches dependency and lockfile surfaces but only promotes the existing tsx dependency to runtime scope for private package installability. `npm audit --omit=dev --audit-level=moderate` exits 0 with 0 vulnerabilities. The work adds no package-manager scripts, CI/release workflows, fetched prompts, external tool installs, public npm publishing, paid registry setup, hosted services, automatic self-update, telemetry, merge, push, or deploy authority.
